1.w: And Abraham journeyed from there to the Negev, and he dwelt between Kadesh and between Shur, and he sojourned in Gerar.

2.w: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, “She [is] my sister.” And Abimelech king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.

3.w: And God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken—and she is married to a husband.”

4.w: And Abimelech has not come near her, and he said, “Lord, will You slay even a righteous nation?

5.w: Did not he say to me, ‘She [is] my sister’? And even she herself said, ‘He [is] my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and in the innocence of my hands I have done this.”

6.w: And God said to him in the dream, “Indeed, I myself knew that you did this in the integrity of your heart, and I withheld you, indeed I, from sinning against Me; upon thus I did not let you touch her.

7.w: And now return the man’s wife, for he [is] a prophet. And he will pray for you, and you shall live. But if you do not return [her], know that you will surely die—you and all that is yours.”

8.w: And Abimelech rose early in the morning and called all his servants, and he told all these words in their ears; and the men were exceedingly afraid.

9.w: And Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, “What have you done to us? And how have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? Deeds that are not to be done, you have done to me.”

10.w: And Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

11.w: And Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God [is] not in this place, and they will kill me on account of my wife.’

12.w: And indeed she [is] also my sister, the daughter of my father but not the daughter of my mother. And she became my wife.

13.w: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from the house of my father, that I said to her, ‘This [is] your kindness that you should do for me: In every place where we go there, say of me, “He [is] my brother.”’”

14.w: And Abimelech took flock, and cattle, and menservants, and maidservants, and he gave [them] to Abraham, and he returned to him Sarah his wife.

15.w: And Abimelech said, “Behold, my land [is] before you. Dwell wherever is good in your eyes.”

16.w: And to Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given a thousand [pieces] of silver to your brother; behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes, to all who [are] with you, and before all you are vindicated.”

17.w: And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants, and they bore [children].

18.w: For YHWH had completely closed all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah the wife of Abraham.
